reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2) discusses CoCrFeNiCu and AlCoCrFeNiWx alloys, which do not contain Mg and are unrelated to Mg diffusion, phase transformations in Mg-containing lightweight HEAs, or their corrosion/oxidation behavior. No specific prior evidence is provided for any of the key premises.
premises: Mg is highly mobile in non-equilibrium microstructures and diffuses upon thermal exposure
Mg diffusion drives a phase transformation from a homogeneous metastable solid solution to segregated Mg-rich intermetallics and a passivating-element-enriched matrix
This evolution leads to a more adherent, composite oxide scale during high-temperature oxidation
The change in phase dispersion reduces microgalvanic couples, altering corrosion behavior
The predicted outcome is lower oxidation mass gain and altered corrosion current density relative to the as-cast baseline
